text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple organized body paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how clearly the essay groups ideas into separate sections and develops them in a more controlled structure."},{"evidence":"connected explanation from imagination to stories, buildings, music, art, and identity","quality":"development","description":"This captures fuller elaboration of ideas with examples and extended explanation rather than brief, fragmented points."},{"evidence":"mostly readable sentences with few language breaks","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures more consistent grammatical control and easier sentence-to-sentence readability."},{"evidence":"vocabulary like \"intricate,\" \"mesmerized,\" \"prosthetic,\" and \"biomechanics\"","quality":"word choice","description":"This captures more precise and varied vocabulary used to express ideas more effectively."},{"evidence":"paragraphs that stay on the same central idea","quality":"coherence","description":"This captures how ideas stay on topic and connect logically within and across paragraphs."},{"evidence":"few non-English intrusions","quality":"language consistency","description":"This captures sustained writing in English with far fewer switches into another language."}]}
